SC-006(b) requires 'programmatically detecting a horizontal line at autocorrelation = 0' in the generated image, but T014's unit test verifies only 'presence of the zero-contour artist' via a recorded artist list during re-plotting — it never inspects the rendered PNG. Given T014 was previously rejected for broken rendering, artist-presence verification would not catch a repeat. Add a pixel-level check (e.g., detect the dashed black contour row in the saved PNG via PIL) or state the deviation explicitly.

US-3 acceptance scenario 2 requires the heatmap PNG to 'pass an automated checksum verification', but T026 computes SHA-256 'for all files under data/' only — outputs/figures/ PNGs are never checksummed. Extend T026's manifest (or T014) to cover the three heatmap PNGs.

T012 bundles five sub-deliverables (adjusted-window construction, batched permutation runs, dual-threshold comparison logic, CSV writer, degradation guard) plus a unit test into one task — too coarse for deterministic execution. Flag for atomization into ~4 tasks (construction, computation+comparison, output+guard, test).

T026 consolidates the orchestrator rewrite, SC-003/SC-004 enforcement, checksum manifest, quickstart update, and a full integration test with fault injection — too coarse. Flag for atomization (orchestrator, resource guards, checksums+docs, integration test).

T016 must summarize results against SC-001, but SC-001's pass threshold is literally '[deferred]' and no task resolves it, so the implementer cannot produce a pass/fail statement for the primary success criterion. Root cause is spec-level; either the spec must supply the threshold or T016 must be scoped to report the measured CI-coverage proportion without a pass/fail claim.
